question:
Which figure from the given options would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aadc74e13c9bea30e66f363a3bd19d48f9aedb20bf01880433405cd330d633e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: B, T, and Δ are shifting a place right in the next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc0e21314da2a13559f18b637c01b4cde770fde27eaf7cbbe7c45880f6f1e30e.png] 

And, 〇, ↑, ▢ and 2 rotate 180 degrees clockwise to the next image and then rotate 90 degrees anticlockwise to the next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6826338a0502e5d974e1359921778d26d93a83f4eff0e8acff72c10b7fb89f67.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244715c94bf4a974b899b10f665bb751f6c773e3fd558ae82724a33a7db224da.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/263f72e2d317496fa5a2d95e6183e5b1b42546fc691351897fab4a96f8ad047e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
